verdict.rationale: Atlas documents that it provides a registered agent to satisfy Delaware compliance requirements. A registered agent is the role that accepts service of process at a physical address, so the product owns the core mechanism. However, the docs give only that single mention and say nothing about how legal papers are handled once received. Missing for 10: evidence of a real street-address office accepting service, scanning or upload of served documents into the Atlas account, a same-day turnaround commitment, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
